purpose.consumer: every render job in pipeline/jobs/ -- this is the `after:` dependency they all carry. Also the lead's status report: its artifact is the box's own statement of whether it can render right now.
purpose.why: A job pointing at an unapproved node does not fail, it raises SystemExit and takes the whole daemon down with it (farm_worker.py:517). Checking before queueing is the difference between one red job and a card that stops.
purpose.success: preflight.yaml exists on the box and reads `verdict: READY`, with 001-capability-inventory and 002b-first-citizen both `approved: true` and a CUDA device named. A `verdict: BLOCKED` is a successful measurement of a real problem, and shows up as rc 1 -- read the `problems:` list rather than re-running it.
